collection.description: A family disagrees about a deceased scholar's wish that their body be used for study.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A deceased scholar once said they wanted their body used for study. Their family remembers the conversation differently.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Records support limited study; the family helps decide respectful boundaries.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The family chooses burial; researchers preserve the scholar's notes instead.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The village develops consent practices for future generations without rewriting the past.
